title: Frances Probable NDE 3691
content: I was coming out of surgery for a simple procedure. It was two weeks after my baby was born. I was trying to come out of the anesthesia and a heard a nurse say, 'She isn't awake yet. Let her sleep a little longer.' It was then it happened. I felt so very sleepy, but unable to say I was awake. The next thing I felt separate from my body and woke up in black but only for a second, not even a second. I then was slowly going toward light and as I progressed toward it, I felt almost layers of myself falling away - I became lighter and lighter and happier - just so happy. I was in a tunnel of very white light and I saw a group of people who loved me. I don't know who they were, but they were familiar to me. No words were said but I felt the pure joy of being there, such incredible relief. There were many women young and old. It was short people, maybe children, and then very small beings to very tiny beings the size of a chick. They were in a shadow, but standing in light. It was like I was not allowed to see them fully. I wanted to join them so badly - like I just wanted to jump into the middle of them - to be at one with them for where they were standing was in a more happier place than I was in - even though where I was, was very happy too. For some reason, I could not go further. I don't remember if I was given a choice but someone from both within the crowd, in the middle, with grey hair was talking to me without words but was also beside me in my ear - we talked with our heads, our thoughts - we discussed me staying and me going back. It, he or she, I don't know which, reminded me of my baby son just born - I had almost forgotten his need of me. We talked about how I could choose to stay, but that I should remember that I am a mother. Not that I was needed per se, or that I felt guilty about staying, but chose to go back because I wanted to be his mother. I also wanted the growth I needed from the remainder of my life lived out - as it was conveyed to me I needed more growing, learning. I chose to go back. I felt so sad to leave, reluctant but took it on the chin to go back. When I awoke, it was a real painful experience and I finally had use of my muscles and asked the nurse, 'Where are all the people?' She said, 'What people?' I could not believe she didn't know. I was angry she didn't know what I was talking about or didn't see them. I felt angry to be back. I feel a loss of interest in my life now. I love my son. But I just don't seem to care about bonds between me and people as much as I used to. I can't seem to feel closed to just one person, but feel close to many. I find myself falling in love with every person. I was already a bit like this, but now I am even more so. I have been with five men since then and each one I feel exactly the same about. My child as well, I feel no special bond, only my duty. I love him yes, but just like I love everyone. It scares me that maybe I am not as good a mother as I once was. Also, I am so much more relaxed, I don't care about time so much, or jobs. I find myself alone a lot, walking. I am more at peace, but feel a bit sad I cannot be with those people. I also feel frustrated that my life hasn't changed dramatically or that I haven't some great mission. I feel like I must have not gotten it all or cheated that I don't have something profound to say, other than I want to go back. I didn't feel a terrible need to tell anyone. I don't think I am crazy or feel ashamed; just felt it was more of extension of who I already am, only intensified, I don't know if any of this is making sense. Now I think of it, I feel alone in it somewhat. I feel a bit selfish now reading what others have gotten out of it, that I didn't tell people of it, I guess it felt so natural that it didn't seem important, except to me. Why did I not see anyone I knew? Why was I not allowed to see their faces fully? Why was I in the light and they were in the light but they were in a shadow barely able to make out? Why was I kept close enough yet far enough away to not reach them? Who spoke to me? And could the smaller beings really be animals? Why did I not get some great life-changing mission or personality change? Why am I the same after, if any change it's one of relaxation, to where nothing seems to matter, not in a sad way, but in an acceptance way?

out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: Felt very sleepy; then 'felt separate from my body' and briefly 'woke up in black'.

arrival.other_being_detail: A group of familiar-but-unknown people who loved her; many women young and old; short people/maybe children; 'very small beings to very tiny beings the size of a chick' partially obscured ('in a shadow... like I was not allowed to see them fully'). One grey-haired being communicated with her.

environment.environment_other_detail: Brief blackness, then 'a tunnel of very white light'; the group stood 'in light' but also 'in a shadow'.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Coming out of anesthesia after a simple procedure, two weeks postpartum.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Brief blackness/void-like moment; 'layers of myself falling away' while moving toward light.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE followed by a moment of blackness, then movement toward light/tunnel, encounter with a loving group, then inability to go further and a choice/discussion to return.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Described 'layers of myself falling away' as she moved toward the light; beings were partially obscured ('in a shadow') and included 'very small beings... the size of a chick' that she wondered might be animals.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: 'I was in a tunnel of very white light and I saw a group of people who loved me.'; 'we talked with our heads, our thoughts'; 'I felt so sad to leave, reluctant...'; 'When I awoke, it was a real painful experience... asked the nurse, "Where are all the people?"'
